integrity: The lower bound is a direct conditional-variance decomposition on the endpoint group. The upper bound uses the exact cumulative-cut expansion of a finite ordered support and the L2 triangle inequality. Boundary sequences and connectedness give the complete attainable sets; exact-rational computation is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for finite laws with fixed positive atom probabilities and variable distinct ordered support.
Except for the two-point case and the three-point lower endpoint, the sharp constants are boundary limits rather than attained values.
The originality search was targeted and may miss an equivalent result in older weighted finite-population inequality literature.
title: Exact fixed-profile range of variance relative to squared range
